svg.title: Never lose an event, never count one twice
svg.desc: The API saves the price and an outbox row in one transaction. A relay publishes it to Kafka after the broker confirms. The worker records each event id, so a repeat does nothing.
svg.text: saving to a database and telling Kafka are two different systems...
so we never do both directly. we do this:
the row is still marked unsent, so the relay sends
it when it comes back. nothing lost.
the worker has already recorded that event id,
so the second copy does nothing. nothing
bad message that can't be read? it goes to a dead-letter topic instead of blocking the line.
